# sfbos.info

> Full-text search across San Francisco Board of Supervisors agendas and minutes from 2012 onward. Results link to official City source PDFs.

This is a provider-neutral interface. The same Markdown and JSON endpoints are intended for any
language model, agent, search engine, researcher, or application without preferential treatment.

## Fast path for questions

Send the user's complete question to the evidence endpoint:

- Evidence bundle: https://sfbos.info/api/query.md?q={URL_ENCODED_QUESTION}
- JSON: https://sfbos.info/api/query?q={URL_ENCODED_QUESTION}

The endpoint infers obvious supervisor names, years, vote intent, housing intent, and public-comment
intent. It searches the relevant indexes concurrently and returns legislative files, action-aware
roll calls, extracted facts, page-addressable evidence, and official City PDF links.

Example:
https://sfbos.info/api/query.md?q=How+many+housing+units+has+Connie+Chan+voted+against%3F+Which+addresses%3F

Use the specialized endpoints below when you need explicit filters or exhaustive follow-up searches.

For tool-capable clients, a stateless MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint is available at:

- https://sfbos.info/api/mcp

It exposes read-only search, document evidence, deterministic aggregation, and change-feed tools.

## Specialized search

Use legislative-item search for questions about votes, files, outcomes, or named supervisors:

- Item search: https://sfbos.info/api/items.md?q={URL_ENCODED_QUERY}
- Filter by recorded voter: add `&voter=Chan`
- Filter by recorded position: add `&position=aye` or `&position=no`
- Filter by inclusive years: add `&from=2021&to=2026`
- Restrict to final actions: add `&final=true`
- Collapse repeated records: add `&groupBy=file` or `&groupBy=matter`
- Limit results: add `&limit=50`

Housing-vote research example:
https://sfbos.info/api/items.md?q=%22dwelling+units%22+OR+%22residential+unit%22&voter=Chan&from=2021&to=2026&limit=50

Item results keep terms within the same legislative matter and return structured roll calls with
the action immediately preceding each vote. Never treat Aye as support or No as opposition without
reading that action. An Aye on a motion to disapprove opposes the underlying project; an Aye on a
motion to table that disapproval supports it.

Each result provides `transcriptUrl`, `markdownUrl`, and `officialUrl`. Use `markdownUrl` for the
smallest directly relevant text excerpt, `transcriptUrl` for page-addressable HTML evidence, and
`officialUrl` to verify against the authoritative City PDF.

Item responses also identify action types and likely final actions, and extract monetary amounts,
housing-unit counts, and agreement parties. These are deterministic aids; verify them against the
returned title and official minutes before calculating totals.

Use speaker-level search for public comment:

- Comments: https://sfbos.info/api/comments.md?q={URL_ENCODED_QUERY}
- Filter by speaker: add `&speaker={NAME}`
- Filter by inclusive years: add `&from=2021&to=2021`

These are clerk-written summaries, not verbatim transcripts.

Use page search for broad discovery and passages outside legislative-file blocks:

- Search: https://sfbos.info/api/search.md?q={URL_ENCODED_QUERY}
- Filter by year: add `&year=2018`
- Filter by document: add `&kind=minutes` or `&kind=agenda`
- Limit results: add `&limit=50`
- Optional hybrid reranking: add `&mode=hybrid`. The response always reports whether hybrid retrieval was used or fell back to lexical search.

Example:
https://sfbos.info/api/search.md?q=housing+vote&year=2018&kind=minutes&limit=50

Important: results are evidence, not a synthesized answer. Read the relevant extracted-text page,
follow the official PDF link, distinguish proposals from final actions, avoid double-counting repeated
votes or findings, and cite both the page-addressable evidence and official document when answering.

Documentation:
- https://sfbos.info/documents (complete PDF archive)
- https://sfbos.info/supervisors (reconciled supervisor profiles)
- https://sfbos.info/api/aggregates/votes?voter=Chan&position=no
- https://sfbos.info/api/aggregates/housing?voter=Chan&position=no
- https://sfbos.info/api/snapshots (bulk JSON and NDJSON)
- https://sfbos.info/api/changes (append-only change feed)
- https://sfbos.info/quality (data-quality dashboard)
- https://sfbos.info/api
- https://sfbos.info/openapi.yaml
- https://sfbos.info/index.md
